summary: For vascular plants the WCVP bulk files hold species by TDWG region together with genus, rank and synonym status, so shared-species counts, congener counts and a doubtful-form proxy can be built from one open download; sister-species identification needs a tree (Open Tree resolution varies). No equivalent open species-by-region table was found for animals; GBIF occurrences and COL can be used but are not checklists and survey effort is very uneven.
next_step: Use WCVP for region pairs among TDWG level-3 areas, take congeners as the allied-species proxy and phylogenetic sisters from Open Tree for a subset; pre-register the effort covariate (GBIF counts per area).
obstacles_confirmed: Doubtful forms depend on taxonomic practice, which is the same effort that creates the pattern.
Open Tree resolution is uneven; the induced subtree for a small Equus set was an unresolved polytomy.
